When an ApplicationSet lives in repository C and its git generator also reads its config files from C (generator repo G == control repo C), discoverArgoCDDocumentEvidence (go/internal/relationships/yaml_iac_evidence.go, the `configRepo.RepoID == controlRepoID` guard) and discoverStructuredArgoCDEvidence (structured_family_evidence.go, `configRepo.RepoID == sourceRepoID`) skip the whole generator iteration. No DISCOVERS_CONFIG_IN, no deploy-source, no template-source and no destination-platform fact is produced for any repository the template deploys, and the new eshu_dp_argocd_applicationset_template_source_total counter does not see it either. Repro and current pin: the G==C row (knownSilentSkip) of TestApplicationSetRelationInvariants in go/internal/relationships/appset_relation_invariant_test.go. Expected: for a template source D that resolves to a catalog repository other than C, a control -> D DEPLOYS_FROM and the literal-destination RUNS_ON for D, no self-loop (same shape the D == G case emits under #7767), plus a metric outcome so the drop is visible until fixed. Open design questions for the arbiter: reuse ARGOCD_APPLICATIONSET_TEMPLATE_SOURCE or a new kind; whether DISCOVERS_CONFIG_IN C -> C is dropped (self-loop) or recorded differently; golden snapshot and corpus count impact. Acceptance: flip the G==C pin, invariant 2 passes on all 16 rows, corpus re-run reported with exact before/after counts, no fact with SourceRepoID == TargetRepoID. Refs #7767.
